notes.title: Blimps 1.7.5
notes.content: Added the Blackbird Market. Renovated Nester's room. Minor bug fixes and improvements. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.7.0
notes.content: Added the Corporate Cash Cow blimp battle, Hawk version 1.3, and several background art renovations. Minor bug fixes. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.9
notes.content: Added the high-speed plane and "push-button" style animations to several of the game's buttons. Various art renovations and bug fixes. We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: BLIMPS 1.6.4
notes.content: Added the "Race to the Moon Crystal" compete against Space Y, Nile X, and Sir Space to be the first to find the moon crystal! Randomized the starting cash money. Minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.3
notes.content: Added the Automatic Cargo Loader(ACL) upgrade to the Stork Cargo Market. Minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.2
notes.content: Added a passport in the hanger office that features your achievement stamps. Also added a light switch to the hanger's office and break room, so you can now turn off the lights if you like. Fixed more bugs.

notes.title: Blimps 1.6.0
notes.content: Added a cut scene to the VIP lounge entrance and locked up the hanger's office with four keys. Minor bug fixes and enhancements.

notes.title: Blimps 1.5.0
notes.content: Added the Handy Electronic Lesson Provider (H.E.L.P.) computer, a new game intro cut-scene, a printer room with game stats, and various pixel-art renovations.  We hope you enjoy the game. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Blimps 1.3.5
notes.content: Added a Help menu and a World Map Room located at Falcon Flight Control. Also added three game modes, easy, normal, and hard.
